name: menu-to-gameplay
demonstrates: PLAY enters .gameplay: ground lattice, whole-building sprites, player actor, no placeholder text. Rooftop signs are NOT promised: ~1 in 3 BUILDING blocks are signed and empty blocks never are, so ~1 in 4 overall. Gate is human/vision review; assert_running is the only machine check.
